shots.name: panel-at-entry
shots.eval: { __sv.app.sources.close(); const a = document.querySelectorAll('#explainer .src-line a[data-ref]')[2]; a.click(); [a.dataset.ref, document.activeElement && document.activeElement.dataset.id] }

shots.name: panel-search
shots.eval: { const s = document.querySelector('#sources input[type=search]'); s.value = 'propeller'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('#sources .src-count').textContent }

shots.name: panel-topic-moons
shots.eval: { const s = document.querySelector('#sources input[type=search]'); s.value = ''; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const t = document.querySelector('#sources select'); t.value = 'moons'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); document.querySelector('#sources .src-count').textContent }

shots.name: panel-data-unverified
shots.eval: { const t = document.querySelector('#sources select'); t.value = ''; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const s = document.querySelector('#sources input[type=search]'); s.value = 'marouf'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('#sources .src-count').textContent }

shots.name: g-closes
shots.eval: { document.querySelector('#sources .src-list').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyG', key: 'g', bubbles: true })); [document.querySelector('#sources').open, document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName] }

shots.name: help
shots.eval: { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Slash', key: '?' })); document.querySelector('#help .src-open') ? 'sources button present' : 'missing' }
